name: Cognito Forms
description:
Create forms and manage your data without leaving Claude. Describe the form you need and build it instantly, then query submissions, pull files and documents, and make entry changes as responses come in. Whether you're setting up a new intake form, checking on pending applications, or retrieving a signed document, your form data is right there when you need it.

Available on Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans. Setting up the connector requires Administrator access in your Cognito Forms organization.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cognito Forms to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cognito Forms to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cognitoforms.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cognito Forms MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cognito Forms provides these MCP tools: get_document, get_entry, get_entry_views, get_file, get_form_schema, get_forms, manage_entry, provide_mcp_server_feedback, set_form_availability, and get_entries_in_view.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cognito Forms?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cognito Forms in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Cognito Forms MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cognito Forms requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cognito Forms is developed by Cognito Forms. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
